purpose: Shared optimistic LP commit planner for TagDuel event adapters. It returns one immutable patch containing both team LP totals and the next idempotency ledger so the trusted session layer can persist them atomically.
consumers: M447 Solemn Wishes draw LP gain
contract: Requires a TagDuel with exactly two shared team LP containers.
Validates stable event IDs, safe non-negative LP integers and unique bounded event ledgers.
Rejects a stale before-snapshot rather than overwriting a newer concurrent commit.
Duplicate retries return the current shared LP tuple unchanged, even if the original before-snapshot is stale.
Returns teamLifePointsAfter and nextProcessedEventIds together as one commit patch.
Does not mutate the duel, player records, inventory, or caller ledger.
Allows LP above 8000 and records zero-delta events for replay safety.

groups: positive gain, damage and simultaneous team LP changes
safe integer and non-negative LP validation

limitations: This is a planning primitive; the caller must persist the returned LP tuple and ledger in one actual storage transaction.
No central resolver registration, Discord command integration, live gateway validation, merge or deployment is performed.
